name: personal-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio — Vue 3 SPA + FastAPI/MongoDB. Task runner for both applications.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm run api -- sync --all-extras
scripts.dev:api: npm run api -- run uvicorn portfolio_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.check:api: npm run api -- run ruff check . && npm run api -- run ruff format --check . && npm run api -- run mypy src && npm run api -- run pytest
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web run test:coverage && npm run api -- run pytest --cov
scripts.seed: npm run api -- run python -m portfolio_api.seed
scripts.seed:check: npm run api -- run python -m portfolio_api.seed --check
